# Script Event

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Something that happened during script processing.

## Scope note

Events originated by a Script (Python/Swift automation run), distinct from ToolEvent (interactive tool use) and AgentEvent (AI-originated).

## Broader

- [Tool Event](../ToolEvent/) — generic (ISO 25964)
